ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity white contiguous blobs located on the distal ends (tips) of both left and right lobes; central region and peduncle interface are characterized by solid low-intensity black pixels; transitional zones exhibit high-frequency black-on-white mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 75-degree U-shaped central depression with a moderate bounding-box depth relative to the horizontal lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring pixel-amplitude variations (jagged peaks and valleys) of 5-15 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges follow a convex parabolic curve from the distal tips, transitioning into a concave sweep toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-contrast, textured white circular pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks/scratches) visible on the white pigmented surface of the left lobe (viewer perspective).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the terminal ends of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, isolated black circular focal spot located within the white region of the left distal lobe, proximal to the trailing edge.
